g.text: NEW TRIANGULAR ARRAY — 50 mirrored pairs, 0.1–1.0 mm sizes
ALL first layers: 5 mm/s | 255°C nozzle | 70°C bed | K=0.55 | 10 × 0.06 mm layers
Rows 1–4: width 0.162876 mm / flow 1.4. Row 5: width 0.15 mm / flow 1.4 / all layers 5 mm/s.
Build plate top view — front at bottom; each pair is finished before the next
FRONT / Y=0. Shaded corner is the printer exclusion area.

Each object is two mirrored TRIANGULAR paths. Sizes increase left to right; rows print front to back.
Size is the nominal triangle tip spacing used in earlier matrices; original 0.3 mm geometry = 1×.
Both triangle axes scale uniformly. Straight intro/outro stay 10 mm; mirrored straight baselines are ≥1 mm apart.
Rows 1–4 test SPEED, not different flow ratios. Their extrusion per millimetre is identical across speeds.
Row 5 tests a fixed 0.15 mm commanded width with flow 1.4; physical width requires measurement.
Part cooling: OFF layers 1–3, then 40–90% by estimated layer time (30s → 40%, 12s → 90%). Aux OFF.
Deposition acceleration: 500 mm/s² first layers; 2000 mm/s² upper layers. All XY purge-line extrusion: 20 mm/s.
Pressure command: M900 K0.55 L1000 M10. Flow multipliers are baked into E; M221 remains 100%.
Adjacent roads can merge at the smallest spacings. Nominal width is not a guarantee of physical bead width.
Plate envelope: X23.15–235.20, Y13.85–242.15 mm. Model height 0.60 mm; travel clearance Z1.00.
Fan timing includes motion, wipe and retraction estimates; exact PWM for every layer is in the CSV. Labels are not printed.
Static checks passed. This new print combination has not been physically verified.
